newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo Wellcome down after U.S. weakness.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo Wellcome down after U.S. weakness.

text.p: Shares in Glaxo Wellcome Plc dropped in early trading on Tuesday, tracking a decline in the company's ADRs in New York on Monday, dealers said.
The stock was down 13-1/2p at 926 by 0818 GMT, after the ADRs fell $5/8 to $30-5/8.
Dealers said they were not immediately aware of any reason for the decline in the stock in the United States, though other major drug stocks also weakened. Merck fell $3/8 to $85-5/8.
"Glaxo was weaker in New York yesterday," said one dealer, "but there is no obvious reason for the decline."

Pharmacia & Upjohn stock dropped $2-3/4 in New York yesterday to $38-1/8 after the company said its chief executive John Zabriskie, who led the merger of the U.S. and Swedish groups in 1995, would step down.
